描述_EN: the brown specks on this bowl are caused by the presence of other minerals in the nephrite jade. here the brown spots add beauty to the white jade. this natural occurrence was not necessarily considered a defect. chinese craftsmen had long known how to exploit the artistic potential of impure material.
描述_ZN: 这个碗上的棕色斑点是由软玉中的其他矿物引起的。 这里的褐斑为白玉增添了美感。 这种自然现象不一定被认为是一种缺陷。 中国的工匠们早就知道如何利用不纯材料的艺术潜力。
